items.title: Periodic tensor grids and multilinear interpolation
items.statement: Defines the periodic rectangular box, uniform tensor grid, wrapped indices, and tensor-product multilinear interpolation weights.

items.title: A periodic C1 velocity has a global characteristic flow on a finite horizon
items.statement: Proves global existence, uniqueness, periodic equivariance, a finite displacement bound, and a compact trajectory tube for a C1 periodic velocity.

items.title: A transverse backward boundary hit has a certified time and trace error bound
items.statement: Translates the published transverse-event estimate to a first-hit inflow boundary guard and propagates its time and dense-state error through Lipschitz boundary data.

items.title: Explicit Euler characteristic backtracking with multilinear interpolation
items.statement: Defines a finite periodic-box update using the explicit Euler backward foot, coordinatewise periodic wrapping, and nonnegative tensor-product multilinear interpolation without a displacement-to-cell-size restriction.

items.title: Periodic multilinear interpolation is convex and L-infinity contractive
items.statement: Proves nonnegative weights summing to one, positivity, range preservation, and sup-norm contraction for every periodic departure point, regardless of displacement size.

items.title: A periodic C1 characteristic map is an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism
items.statement: Proves inverse-flow identities, invertibility of the spatial derivative, and positive Jacobian determinant throughout the finite horizon.

items.title: Tensor multilinear interpolation has a second-derivative error bound
items.statement: Bounds the periodic tensor-product multilinear interpolation defect by one eighth of the sum of squared coordinate mesh widths times the corresponding second-derivative suprema.

items.title: Explicit Euler gives a second-order local backward-foot defect
items.statement: Proves an O(dt^2) one-step foot error from bounded velocity and bounded time and space derivatives, with no CFL restriction.

items.title: Characteristic departure cells are measurable and have positive finite volume
items.statement: Under Countable Choice, proves that inverse images of finite tensor-grid cells under the periodic characteristic diffeomorphism form a measurable partition and have positive finite Lebesgue volume.

items.title: Characteristic-cell overlap remapping for a conservative density
items.statement: Defines departure cells as inverse images under the characteristic flow, applies exact overlap-volume remapping to source cell averages, and scales by departure-to-arrival cell volume to recover arrival-cell density.

items.title: Periodic semi-Lagrangian error is controlled by local foot and interpolation defects
items.statement: Proves the finite-time sup-norm bound E0 + C T(dt^q + h^(r+1)/dt) under explicit local foot, interpolation stability, and consistency hypotheses, and specializes it to q=r=1 for explicit Euler and multilinear interpolation.

items.title: Characteristic-cell overlap remapping preserves mass and positivity
items.statement: Uses PE17 overlap conservation on the measurable departure/source partitions, then proves that the characteristic volume factor preserves positivity and the arrival-cell total mass.

items.title: A constant-speed foot can cross many cells in one stable update
items.statement: For a periodic constant velocity and a displacement of 4.8 cell widths, computes the wrapped foot and verifies the convex two-node update.

items.title: Refining time alone leaves interpolation diffusion on a fixed grid
items.statement: Computes the Fourier amplification limit for constant-speed periodic advection as dt tends to zero at fixed h, showing that time refinement alone does not remove spatial interpolation error.

items.title: Variable-foot pointwise interpolation can change the grid sum
items.statement: Gives a smooth periodic velocity and three-node data for which the pointwise semi-Lagrangian update changes the grid sum.

items.title: A smooth deforming flow remaps two cell averages conservatively
items.statement: Computes the departure partition and exact overlap volumes for an endpoint-fixing smooth flow, then verifies the remapped averages, positivity, and mass balance.
